sanctions.unban_target: Give the ReadyM account id of the banned player.

sanctions.mute_deny.one: You are muted for {count} more minute.
sanctions.mute_deny.other: You are muted for {count} more minutes.

sanctions.mute_deny_until_lifted: You are muted until the staff lift it.
sanctions.cmd.mute: /amute <number> <minutes> <reason> - no chat at all, 0 minutes until lifted
sanctions.cmd.why: /awhy <number> - why a player may not speak
sanctions.cmd.unmute: /aunmute <number|account id> - lift a mute, of a player who is away too
sanctions.cmd.warn: /awarn <number> <reason> - a warning, kept in the player's history
sanctions.cmd.freeze: /afreeze <number> <reason> - hold a character where it stands until lifted
sanctions.cmd.unfreeze: /aunfreeze <number|account id> - let a frozen character go, of a player who is away too
